objective: Full NEAR state transition at 1 Pgas, hash-based quantum-resistant compression, Lean correctness
capacity_warning: Gas-capacity ratio only; NOT a proved trace count or operator bound

restrictions.text: protocol_version = 86 (nearcore 2.13.4) for every epoch of the claim, mainnet runtime parameters RuntimeConfigStore::new(None).get_config(86)
the epoch's shard layout is ShardLayout V2 or V3 with 1..=64 shards
all epochs of the claim have the byte-identical shard layout (no resharding); no non-empty outgoing buffer to a shard outside the layout
block headers V6; chunk header inners V4/V5
no dynamic-resharding split check for any applied block
the last new chunk of the shard is not the genesis chunk
the chain segment has at most 32 blocks
state witness <= 8 MiB; sum of the main transition's base_state values and the contract code blobs + 2000 x ContractData removals <= 4,000,000 bytes (the storage-proof limit never triggers)

no DeployGlobalContract / UseGlobalContract / DeterministicStateInit action, no GlobalContractDistribution receipt, no ML-DSA-65 key in any decoded transaction or receipt (incl. receipts created by contracts); transactions carry ED25519 keys and signatures
no SECP256K1 Delegate signature is verified
the BandwidthSchedulerState value is absent or decodes as V1

every executed contract prepares inside D3α: integer WASM only (no float type or opcode); no executed FunctionCall calls a curve host function (alt_bn128_*, bls12381_*, ecrecover, p256_verify) or a state-init / global-contract / gas-key host function (importing them is allowed); no unmodeled VM outcome
every FunctionCall receiver's contract is None or Local (global identifiers out of domain); no FunctionCall on an ETH-implicit account with a Local contract (legacy-wallet resolution)

cold-cache statement: the code of every executed pre-state contract must be in the witness (else reject); out of domain when such a blob is absent and the same code was deployed earlier in the chunk (committed or rolled back): nearcore's verdict then depends on its compiled-contract cache
the chunk's sum of gas_burnt_for_function_call (incl. host gas) <= G_alpha = 2^22 x 822,756 gas (NearSpecV3.D3.gAlpha), checked after the main transition
